title: 第五章 不是不想输实在是对手拉了个大的第六章 输不了一点哥们的家伙比你的大
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: “七十七？”
不多时，抽签结束，秦凡抽的木牌号码比较靠后。
好在，杂务广场不小，能同时容纳几十人交手。
只等第一轮结束，第二轮就轮到他，不必等太久。
也恰好，趁这个机会观摩一下其他人的比试。
四十名杂役弟子站定，大道混元钟再度被敲响。
比试开始的信号刚一出现，广场上，剧烈的碰撞声便瞬间响起，“砰砰砰”，刀剑拳脚，火光四溅，你来我往，互不相让，那叫一个激烈。
虽说老孟没讲，但，按照惯例，前十都会有奖励，为了这些奖励，一个个施展出浑身解数。
一开始，秦凡看的还算热闹，只是打着打着，他觉得不对劲了。
法术呢？灵符呢？
对波啊，玩毛线体术，这是摇光圣地，不是特娘的摇坎达！
只想学习一下法术运用而已，能给个机会吗兄弟们？
就在秦凡心下无语的时候，孟祥辉缓步来到了近前。
“考虑好了吗？”
秦凡叹了口气，点了点头，“考虑好了，走个过场就打算走人，毕竟小命最重要。”
“不错。”孟祥辉欣赏的拍了拍秦凡肩膀，“是个聪明人，以后在俗世遇到麻烦了，可以回圣地找我，有时间我一定帮你。”
有时间……
真是很微妙的一个词，不愧是你，扒皮老孟，画饼都画的抠搜的。
“铛铛铛——”
就在两人说话间，拳拳到肉的第一轮考核已经结束。
这就是杂役弟子之间的较量，最强的，也就炼气三层，弱的，炼气一层。
不整点蓝色小药丸补充灵力，没啥持久性。
败者，趾高气昂，输了的，唉声叹气，但绝望的没几个。
因为都知道，这一届杂役弟子中，有秦凡垫底。
“第二轮准备！”有执事弟子大喊。
“到你了。”
孟祥辉拍了拍秦凡肩膀，“上去就认输吧，速战速决，到时候我去你那里陪你喝两杯，给你践行，不过我最近手头紧，你先给酒钱垫上，等宽裕了我再还你。”
真的不愧是你。
懒得废话，秦凡大步来到七十七号场地，不用说，对手王大彪无疑。
抽签有内幕，已经不是啥新鲜事了。
“来了来了！”
“王大彪对秦凡，你们说这废物能撑多久？”
“我猜一招秒。”
content_en:
"Seventy-seven?"
Not long after, the draw ended, and Qin Fan drew a wooden card with a relatively low number.
Fortunately, the chore square is not small and can accommodate dozens of people fighting at the same time.
Just wait for the first round to end, and it will be his turn in the second round. He doesn't have to wait too long.
It just so happens that I take this opportunity to observe other people's competition.
"Cang!"
Forty servant disciples stood still, and the Great Avenue Hunyuan Bell was rung again.
As soon as the signal for the start of the competition appeared, violent collisions suddenly sounded in the square, "bang bang bang", swords and fists, and fire flying everywhere. You came and I went back and forth, not giving in to each other, it was called fierce.
Although Lao Meng didn't say it, as usual, there will be rewards for the top ten, and for these rewards, each of them will do their best.
At first, Qin Fan saw it was quite lively, but as he was slapping, he felt something was wrong.
What about spells? Where's the magic talisman?
Duo Bo, let’s play with woolen body skills. This is the holy land of shaking light, not the special girl’s shaking kanda!
I just want to learn how to use magic. Can you give me a chance, brothers?
Just when Qin Fan was speechless, Meng Xianghui slowly came closer.
"Have you considered it?"
Qin Fan sighed and nodded, "I've thought about it, and I'm going to leave after going through the motions. After all, my life is the most important."
"Not bad." Meng Xianghui patted Qin Fan on the shoulder with appreciation, "He is a smart man. If you encounter trouble in the world in the future, you can come back to the Holy Land to find me. I will definitely help you when I have time."
Have time...
It’s such a subtle word. As expected of you, the arrogant old Meng, you are so good at drawing cakes.
"Dang Dang Dang——"
While the two were talking, the first round of fist-to-flesh assessment had ended.
This is the competition between the handyman disciples. The strongest one is on the third level of Qi refining, and the weak one is on the first level of Qi refining.
If you don't take some little blue pills to replenish your spiritual power, it won't last long.
The losers are arrogant, those who lost are sighing, but few are in despair.
Because everyone knows that among the handyman disciples of this year, Qin Fan is at the bottom.
"Get ready for the second round!" a deacon disciple shouted.
"It's your turn."
Meng Xianghui patted Qin Fan on the shoulder, "Just admit defeat when you go up. Let's make a quick decision. Then I'll go to your place and have a drink with you to help you put it into practice. However, I'm short of money recently, so you can pay for the drinks first, and I'll pay you back when I'm rich."
"..."
Really worthy of you.
Not bothering to talk nonsense, Qin Fan strode to venue No. 77. Needless to say, his opponent Wang Dabiao was undoubtedly his opponent.
There is an inside story in the lottery, which is nothing new.
"Coming, coming!"
"Wang Dabiao and Qin Fan, how long do you think this waste can last?"
"I guess it's one move in seconds."
title_en: Chapter 5: It’s not that I don’t want to lose, but it’s because my opponent has made a big mistake. Chapter 6: I can’t lose a bit, my brother’s guy is bigger than yours.
